overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Total Return ETF (TOTR) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on broad credit fixed income. TOTR is an actively managed fund that provides diversified exposure to US fixed income securities. TOTR was launched on Sep 28, 2021 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
